message.reasoning_content:
The plateau is at 0.7670 with the current best. Recent attempts (0.7606) actually regressed. The trajectory shows the model has been stuck around 0.764-0.767. Need a Tier 2 or Tier 3 change.

Key insight: The DeepFM and LR add no value (DeepFM OOF ~0.740 vs LGBM ~0.755). CatBoost attempt regressed. Feature engineering is the bottleneck.

What could genuinely help? This is the classic Bank Marketing coupon dataset. The best approaches use gradient boosting with proper categorical handling and good hyperparameters, plus careful feature engineering. Random forest/XGBoost/LightGBM ensembles help a bit.

The best realistic improvement: 
1. Stronger LGBM hyperparameter tuning (Tier 1/2)
2. Replace the whole NN/LR complexity with a wide XGBoost + LGBM ensemble (Tier 3 - simplify ensemble paradigm)
3. Better feature engineering — the key interactions are coupon×direction×expiration, distance features already partly done.

Given plateau, I'll go Tier 3: remove the over-parameterized DeepFM which is clearly hurting (adds noise to the stack), replace with a proper GBDT trio: LightGBM + XGBoost + a strong LGBM with different hyperparameters, plus tune threshold. Also add XGBoost since it handles categoricals differently and adds real diversity.

Also consider: gradient boosting with target encoding combined. Actually the CatBoost attempt regressed because it was combined with the existing noisy DeepFM.

Let me focus: model_design (replace ensemble) + training_evaluation (selection logic).

Actually the cleaner improvement: drop DeepFM and LR from the stack (they're noise contributors), use LGBM + XGBoost + CatBoost ensemble with proper cat handling, select best via OOF. This is Tier 3 (diversity from real GBDTs vs degenerate NN).

Let me commit to this plan.

Modules: model_design, training_evaluation.

I'll keep feature engine mostly as-is but add a couple safe interactions in feature engineering too? Keep atomic — focus on model + training. But the guidance allows 1-3 modules. I'll do model_design and training_evaluation.

Let me write the plan.
